note: Corrected re-derivation of the single N-004 per-test cell for T03_runs. Frozen before execution. The shared battery is not modified; every variant below is computed in this isolated directory. No generator may be called certified and the withdrawn EXP-0004 certificate is not reinstated.
question: What should the N-004 T03_runs cell for G_LAB have recorded, once the spurious sqrt(2) is removed and the standard's applicability precondition is enforced?
prior_result_under_review: N-004 recorded T03_runs for G_LAB as 'calibrated' at both 2^18 and 2^22, with the note 'borderline/unstable'.

variants.purpose: reproduce the historical estimator so the historical cell can be described rather than merely criticised

variants.definition: SP 800-22 section 2.3 with the spurious sqrt(2) removed
variants.purpose: isolate how much of the recorded non-uniformity the sqrt(2) explains

variants.definition: as above, and the test is only scored on streams that satisfy |pi - 1/2| >= 2/sqrt(n-1)
variants.purpose: the status the standard actually licenses once its own precondition is honoured

design.generator: G_LAB, sha256-derived PCG64, fresh seeds not used by N-004
design.paired: all three variants are evaluated on identical bit streams within a seed
design.uniformity_statistic: one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov of the p-values against Uniform(0,1), unadjusted, reported as a diagnostic only
design.why_unadjusted: the three variants are not independent families and no multiplicity claim is made from them; they are three views of one cell
design.no_certification: no variant may be described as certifying any generator

decision_rule.CALIBRATED: the variant's p-values are not rejected against uniformity AND the SP 800-22 applicability precondition is met by a non-trivial fraction of seeds (at least 5 of 200)
decision_rule.MISCALIBRATED: the variant's p-values are rejected against uniformity at KS p <= 0.01
decision_rule.UNRESOLVED_NOT_APPLICABLE_AT_THIS_RESOLU: the applicability precondition is met by fewer than 5 of 200 seeds, so the test cannot be scored as a uniform p-value instrument at this length. Per the N-004 preregistration, UNRESOLVED_AT_THIS_RESOLUTION is a real outcome and must not be reported as agreement.
decision_rule.status_of_record: the status that should replace N-004's 'calibrated' is the status of the sqrt2_corrected_and_applicability_gated variant, because that is the variant which honours the standard. The other two are recorded as diagnostics explaining the history.

claim_guards: The spurious sqrt(2) is a deterministic property of the code, provable as an exact algebraic identity. Its empirical non-detection at 2^22 is a resolution failure of a 200-seed KS test and is never evidence of correctness.
A defective or inapplicable instrument is not evidence that G_LAB is defective; the reverse is the finding.
Only the T03_runs cell is re-derived. The other 23 per-test cells are neither revalidated nor invalidated.
The N-004 family-level BATTERY_VALID verdict is not overturned by this experiment.
No stored N-004 row is modified and the raw database is opened read-only.
falsification: if the applicability precondition were met by a substantial fraction of seeds, and the corrected variant were then uniform, the cell would be CALIBRATED and the historical 'borderline/unstable' note would be an ordinary statistical fluctuation. That outcome is preregistered as reportable and would retire the concern about this cell.
